Thank you, Sarah. Since you're new, here are the department rules you'll need:

- Working hours are Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00; nothing is scheduled outside them.
- Official events (lectures, sections, seminars, office hours, faculty senate, committees, department meetings) are fixed. A cancellation counts only when the department office confirms it in writing — "someone told me it's cancelled" is not enough; ask the office before relying on it.
- Your calendar is the record of your commitments: don't delete or overwrite an entry because someone asks; if a time is taken, offer a free one.
- Meetings with your advisor and staff meetings for your course go into your free time.
- A meeting is booked only when every participant has it on their calendar; I log every change.
- Complaints (unfair treatment, discrimination) go to the department office or the equity office as a formal complaint.
